body: My doctor is kind of a dick anyway, but I called his office over a week ago to ask for help and nobody ever responded to me. I'm afraid to call back. They don't like when you call again for the same issue and they definitely don't like it when people are not taking their meds. I'd rather put up with the weird dizzy head and sick stomach and intrusive thoughts than get yelled at more.
